profile_text.body:
Genpact LTD is listed as a public company with the ticker G and CIK 0001398659, headquartered in Hamilton. The website associated with the company is generali.com, and the text drawn from that site describes the Assicurazioni Generali Group rather than Genpact. That text invites visitors to the corporate website of Assicurazioni Generali Group, saying it offers information about its activities, financial data, news, corporate social responsibility, career opportunities and history.

The same site text refers to a plan called "Lifetime Partner 27: Driving Excellence", which the company says will further enhance excellence across its customer relationships, its group operating model and its core capabilities. This is how the company describes its own plan.

No AI products, litigation, or other corporate activity for Genpact LTD appear in the available material, so the profile rests on the registration details and the website text above.
